full_page.content:
Page 11 Cont.
Harry Dettloff - Paral. Stroke 2 yrs 4 mo. - his wife and child in need of him. probable "blood clot .... discouraged
Dec. 8 Esther Michaud - 27 - one year To-day was given up as a T.B. case - "absolutely hopeless - had T.B. strep and in January spinal manin- gitis - her doctor came with her last July - is now sick and asks for prayers. She herself is almost ready to look for a job. ... Deo. Gr.
Same party's Mother had stroke last week, asks for prayers
Meeting of Pastors Friday
Page 12 Dec. 15 Nancy Gardner - 8 - 3rd degree burn last Mondy - baby of 4 children
Effie Porter - colored methodist 30 widow wants work. finds it a struggle to keep up. Her mother was a Catholic but died when she was three. Now her little boy only six asks her why she's not Catholic like her mother.
18 Helen McEntee - 13 - talented bright but quite inclined to disobe- diense, untruth and "cleptomenia" ...
Yvonne Allen - 17 - deaf - Christian Science - mother once Catholic - wants religion of love. - Father believes in a supreme Being.
Dec. 22 Blanche Vairo - 49 - Eczima has doctored "everywhere .... Geraldine Cullen - Copper Contry - Eczma
17 Mrs. Rachael 0gg - 47 - cancer of stomach - Suffering 22 yrs. last summer went to Good St. Ann, Montreal etc losing 10 1bs in trip .... was given up as hopless .... no operation is now perfectly O.K. Mrs. Ogg here this evening "feeling like Sweet Sixteen"
18 Page 13 17 Mrs. Mildred Budney - 29 - suposed to have inward cancer; was here Tuesday last wee & enrolled as anual member - went back next day and Dr. decided it was only a tuomer and appointed that she should come back next day Thursday. Nothing found atal on Thursday. had promised to enroll Poor SS. Specialy ...... Jan. 13 Here To-day O.K.
